status: post hoc recovery after observing capped exact-rejection SBC cases
purpose: Complete SBC cases that the bounded exact joint-prior rejection fallback cannot finish
likelihood_estimator: Mean of eight independent nuisance-realization Gaussian densities; for multiple observations, multiply their Gaussian densities within each realization before averaging
thinning: Evenly spaced draws from each converged chain, then shuffled
routing: A pair using this fallback is excluded from SBI routing
limitations: Finite-chain diagnostics support but do not prove convergence; the fallback is evaluated separately from the production SBI sampler.
